title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on Genesis 11: the tower of Babel, the generations of Shem, and Terah's family on the way to Canaan.

questions.text: What was true of the whole earth at the start of the chapter?
questions.explanation: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.

answers.text: It was ruled by one king
It was still covered with water
It was divided into many nations
It had one language and one speech

questions.text: Where did the people settle as they traveled from the east?
questions.explanation: As they traveled from the east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there.

answers.text: The city of Ur of the Chaldees
A plain in the land of Shinar

questions.text: What did the builders use for mortar?
questions.explanation: They had brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar.

questions.text: Why did the people want to build a city and a tower?
questions.explanation: They said, "Let's make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth."

answers.text: To make a name for themselves
To store grain for a famine

questions.text: What did Yahweh do to stop the builders?
questions.explanation: Yahweh confused their language so that they would not understand one another's speech, and scattered them abroad.

answers.text: He destroyed the tower with fire

questions.explanation: Its name was called Babel, because there Yahweh confused the language of all the earth.

questions.text: How old was Shem when he became the father of Arpachshad?
questions.explanation: Shem was one hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad, two years after the flood.

questions.text: Who was the son of Haran?
questions.explanation: Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.

questions.text: What does the chapter say about Sarai, Abram's wife?
questions.explanation: The name of Abram's wife was Sarai. Sarai was barren; she had no child.

answers.text: She was barren and had no child
She was the wife of Nahor
She died in Ur of the Chaldees

questions.explanation: Terah set out from Ur of the Chaldees to go into Canaan, came to Haran and lived there. Terah died in Haran.
